node.statement: Unit-action step. Let C_u,e_u be witnesses from lem-compcb-compressed-unit-action. For P_n=I_n tensor P and u_{P,n}=Co_{P_n}(P_n), the external applied to the amplified square corner gives, whenever e<=e_u, ||u_{P,n} dot A-A||<=C_u*e||A|| and ||A dot u_{P,n}-A||<=C_u*e||A|| at every n.
